biggest_catch: The referred member must make 10 debit card purchases AND a direct deposit within 60 days — both requirements, not just one.
catches: The referred member must make 10 debit card purchases and a direct deposit within 60 days of account opening.
The friend must enter the referrer's unique referral code in the 'promotional code' field during the checking application.
The referred member must not have had a OneAZ account in the past 12 months.
Only personal checking referrals are described; employees/Board/Supervisory Committee members are not eligible.
Annual cap not disclosed on the observed snippet.

c4.evidence: Timing: the $75 bonus is deposited within 15 days of the referred member completing the requirements.

notes: OneAZ Credit Union (Arizona). Distinct from R0604's OneAZ signup bank bonus. The friend's own joining reward is also advertised as $75.
payout_quote: Referring Member (Existing Member) Bonus Information: To receive the $75 bonus, the referred member must establish membership and open a new OneAZ personal checking account. The referred member must use promotional (promo) code at account opening when applying for a checking account. A $75 bonus will be deposited into your Share Savings Account within 15 days of the new member applicant following the steps below.

Friend enters the code in the promotional-code field when opening a OneAZ personal checking account.
Friend makes 10 debit card purchases and a direct deposit within 60 days.
A $75 bonus is deposited into your Share Savings Account within 15 days.
